title: Where should Dashboard Builder live?
decision: Where should the Dashboard Builder emitter live once v1 proves out?
context: Groundwork owns every stage the builder needs. A census of 157 dashboard artifacts found 67 accept input and only 4 write to a durable sink. The review loop is fully wired to port 3847 and has never written a row, because a served bundle no-ops silently when its service is down.

options.label: Build as a Groundwork lane, split later on a named trigger
options.detail: designer/dashboards/ plus a thin skill. Ships immediately; packaging cost deferred until the contract is proven.
tradeoffs: No marketplace or sync cost yet

options.label: Extract to its own repo immediately
options.detail: ~/dev/git-folder/dashboard-builder, symlinked into the toolkit like the other 18 plugins.
tradeoffs: Pays packaging cost before the contract is frozen
Rebuilds nine stages Groundwork already owns

options.label: Generalise research:audit-dashboard in place
options.detail: It is the one working emitter. Widen its schema from audits to contracts.
tradeoffs: Couples dashboards to the research plugin
Its schema is audit-shaped, not decision-shaped
